thread_text:
Maya K.: Heads-up: Pixel the tortoise discovered the office sun patch. Photo drop incoming 🐢☀️
Jonah: omg sunbeam tortoise!! please photo pls pls :raised_hands:
Maya K.: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/PixelSun|image_2026-03-23_1402.png> — slow & majestic. he refused to move for 12 minutes straight 😂
Rita: he looks like a little zen stone. someone give him a tiny robe :joy:
Sam: is it allowed to bring tortoises to the office? also are keyboards fortified against soil migrations? :thinking_face:
Alex: policy says "low-maintenance reptiles OK with prior registration" — @people-ops will confirm but pixel is cleared :wink:
CacheBot: Reminder: pets in office must be registered. See https://intranet/docs/pet-policy. Next steps: upload vaccination pic to the portal.
Maya K.: filed registration this morning and uploaded vax card. also brought a micro basking lamp so Pixel can nap on my desk. No soil on keyboards yet :sweat_smile:
Jonah: can we get a tiny plant friend for Pixel? i volunteer to bring a succulent named Stu 🌵
Rita: Pixel + Stu = sunbeam squad. new office mascots. vote: tuesday pet brunch? :coffee: :heart_eyes:
Alex: :thumbsup: count me in
Sam: officially accepting donations for micro lettuce & tiny tortoise snacks. will set up a dropbox in the kitchen :leafy_green:
